<h2 id="l1-001-hello-world"><strong>L1-001 Hello World</strong></h2>

using namespace std;
int main(){
    cout&lt;&lt;"Hello World!";
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-002-打印沙漏"><strong>L1-002 打印沙漏</strong></h2>
<p>首先观察一个沙漏是由两个金字塔重叠顶部构成的，一个金字塔行数为len     ，每一行用的符号为2<em>i - 1(正立的)  求和1 + 3 + 5 + ...2</em>len  - 1 = len^2</p>
<p>根据总符号数(2*len^2 - 1)计算总行数 2 * len - 1</p>
<p>打印每一行字符即可</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int n ;
    cin&gt;&gt;n;
    char c;
    cin&gt;&gt;c;
    int len ;
    for(int i = 1;2*i*i-1&lt;= n ; i++){
        len = i;
    }
    int cnt=2*len*len-1;
    vector&lt;string&gt; ans(2*len-1);
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; len ;i++){
        ans[i] = string(i,' ');
        ans[i]+=string(2*(len-i)-1,c);
        ans[2*(len-1)-i] = ans[i];
    }
    for(auto s:ans){
        cout&lt;&lt;s&lt;&lt;"\n";
    }
    cout&lt;&lt;n-cnt;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-003-个位数统计"><strong>L1-003 个位数统计</strong></h2>
<p>用数组统计即可</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    string n ;cin&gt;&gt;n;
    int cnt[10] ={0};
    for(char c:n){
        int x  =  c-'0';
        cnt[x]++;
    }

    for(int i = 0; i &lt;= 9;i++){
        if(cnt[i]){
            cout&lt;&lt;i&lt;&lt;":"&lt;&lt;cnt[i]&lt;&lt;"\n";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-005-考试座位号"><strong>L1-005 考试座位号</strong></h2>
<p>哈希表  准考证号 -&gt;{试机座位号 考试座位号}</p>
<p>或者结构体</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include &lt;iostream&gt;
#include &lt;unordered_map&gt;
#include &lt;string&gt;
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    
    unordered_map&lt;int, pair&lt;string, int&gt;&gt; seatMap; // 试机座位号映射准考证号和考试座位号
    
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; ++i) {
        string id;
        int testSeat, examSeat;
        cin &gt;&gt; id &gt;&gt; testSeat &gt;&gt; examSeat;
        seatMap[testSeat] = {id, examSeat};
            //make_pair(id, examSeat);
    }
    
    int m;
    cin &gt;&gt; m;
    int seat;
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; m; ++i) {
        cin &gt;&gt; seat;
        // 输出对应准考证号和考试座位号
        cout &lt;&lt; seatMap[seat].first &lt;&lt; " " &lt;&lt; seatMap[seat].second &lt;&lt; endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-006-连续因子"><strong>L1-006 连续因子</strong></h2>
<p>start 为连续因子的开始第一个数</p>
<p>如果连续因子长度&gt;= 2  只用枚举到sqrt(n) + 1</p>
<p>因为若start &gt; sqrt(n)  ，那么start*(start + 1) &gt; n</p>
<p>那么和假设不符 ,长度只能为1输出即可</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include &lt;iostream&gt;
#include &lt;cmath&gt;
using namespace std;
int main() {
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    int m = sqrt(n) + 1;
    int start = 0,max_len = 0;
    //连续因子长度&gt;= 2 会进入for循环
    for(int i = 2;i &lt;= m ; i++ ){
        if(n%i != 0)    continue;
        int j = i+1;
        int sum = n/i;
        int len = 1;
        while(sum%j==0 &amp;&amp; j&lt;=m){
           sum /= j; 
            len ++;
            j++;
        }
        if(len &gt; max_len){
            start = i;
            max_len = len;
        }
    }
    if(max_len==0){
        //未进入for循环，长度为1
        cout&lt;&lt;1&lt;&lt;endl;
        cout&lt;&lt;n&lt;&lt;endl;
    }
    else{
        cout&lt;&lt;max_len&lt;&lt;endl;
        int f=0;
        for(int i = start ; i&lt; start+max_len;i++){
            if(f)    cout&lt;&lt;"*";
            cout&lt;&lt;i;
            f=1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

    mp['9'] = "jiu";

    string s;cin&gt;&gt;s;

<h2 id="l1-008-求整数段和"><strong>L1-008 求整数段和</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int a,b;
    cin &gt;&gt; a &gt;&gt; b;
    int sum =  0;
    int cnt = 0;
    for(int x = a;x &lt;= b;x++){
        printf("%5d",x);
        sum += x;
        cnt++;
        cnt %= 5;
        if(cnt == 0){
            cout &lt;&lt; "\n";
        }
    }
    if(cnt != 0) cout &lt;&lt; "\n";
    cout &lt;&lt; "Sum = " &lt;&lt; sum;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-009-n个数求和"><strong>L1-009 N个数求和</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
ll gcd(ll x,ll y){
    return y == 0 ? x : gcd(y,x % y);
}
int main(){
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    ll a,b,c,d;
    char ignore;
    cin &gt;&gt; a &gt;&gt; ignore &gt;&gt; b;
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n - 1;i++){
        cin &gt;&gt; c &gt;&gt; ignore &gt;&gt; d;
        a = a*d + b *c;
        b = b*d;
        if(a != 0){
            ll g = gcd(a,b);
            a /= g;
            b /= g;
        }
    }
    ll integer = a / b;
    a -= b * integer;
    if(integer != 0){
        cout &lt;&lt; integer;
    }
    if(integer == 0 &amp;&amp; a == 0) {
        cout &lt;&lt; "0";
    }
    if(integer != 0 &amp;&amp; a != 0){
        cout &lt;&lt; " ";
    }
    if(a != 0){
        cout &lt;&lt; a &lt;&lt; "/" &lt;&lt; b;
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-010-比较大小"><strong>L1-010 比较大小</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    vector&lt;int&gt; a(3);
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; 3;i++) cin &gt;&gt; a[i];
    sort(a.begin(),a.end());
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; 3;i++){
        if(i ) cout &lt;&lt;"-&gt;";
        cout &lt;&lt; a[i];
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-011-a-b"><strong>L1-011 A-B</strong></h2>
<p>哈希表记录一下出现过的字符，出现过的不输出即可</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main()
{
    string a,b;
    getline(cin,a);
    getline(cin,b);
    map&lt;char,bool&gt;vis;
    for(char c:b) vis[c] = true;
    for(char c:a)
    {
        if( vis[c])
        {
            continue;
        }
        cout &lt;&lt; c;
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-013-计算阶乘和"><strong>L1-013 计算阶乘和</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int main(){
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    ll ans = 0;
    ll now = 1;
    for(int i = 1;i &lt;= n;i++){
        now *= i;
        ans += now;
    }
    cout &lt;&lt; ans;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

int main(){
    int col;
    char c;
    cin &gt;&gt; col &gt;&gt; c;
    int row = round(col * 0.5);
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; row;i++){
        for(int j = 0;j &lt; col;j++){
            cout &lt;&lt;c;

<h2 id="l1-016-查验身份证"><strong>L1-016 查验身份证</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    int w[] = {7,9,10,5,8,4,2,1,6,3,7,9,10,5,8,4,2};
    char z[] = {'1','0','X','9','8','7','6','5','4','3','2'};
    bool flag = true;
    for(int i = 0; i &lt; n;i++){
        string s;
        cin &gt;&gt; s;
        bool check = true;
        int sum = 0;
        for(int j = 0;j &lt; 17;j++){
            if(!(s[j] &gt;='0' &amp;&amp; s[j] &lt;='9')) {
                check = false;
                break;
            }
            sum += (s[j] - '0')*w[j];
        }

        if(check &amp;&amp; z[sum % 11] == s[17]){
            continue;
        }else{
            cout &lt;&lt; s &lt;&lt; "\n";
            flag = false;
        }
    }
    if(flag) cout &lt;&lt; "All passed";
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-017-到底有多二"><strong>L1-017 到底有多二</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    string s;
    cin &gt;&gt; s;
    int n = s.size();
    bool isNeg = false;
    bool isEven = (s[n - 1] - '0')%2 == 0;
    int cnt2 = 0;
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++){
        if(s[i] == '-') isNeg = true;
        else{
            cnt2 += (s[i] == '2');
        }
    }
    double ans = 1.0*cnt2 / (n - isNeg);
    if(isNeg) ans *= 1.5;
    if(isEven) ans *= 2.0;
    printf("%.2lf%%",100*ans);
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-018-大笨钟"><strong>L1-018 大笨钟</strong></h2>

int main(){
    int hh,mm;
    scanf("%d:%d",&amp;hh,&amp;mm);
    if(hh &lt;= 12){
        printf("Only %02d:%02d.  Too early to Dang.",hh,mm);
    }else{
        int cnt = hh - 12 + ( mm &gt; 0);

}

<h2 id="l1-019-谁先倒"><strong>L1-019 谁先倒</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int a,b;
    cin &gt;&gt; a &gt;&gt; b;
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    int suma = 0,sumb = 0;
    while(n--){
        int han1,hua1,han2,hua2;
        cin &gt;&gt; han1 &gt;&gt; hua1 &gt;&gt; han2 &gt;&gt; hua2;
        int sum = han1 + han2;
        if(sum == hua1 &amp;&amp; sum == hua2) continue;
        if(sum == hua1) suma++;
        if(sum == hua2) sumb++;
        if(suma &gt; a) {
            cout &lt;&lt; "A\n" &lt;&lt; sumb;
            break;
        }else if(sumb &gt; b){
            cout &lt;&lt; "B\n" &lt;&lt; suma;
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-020-帅到没朋友"><strong>L1-020 帅到没朋友</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
const int N = 100005;
bool hasFriend[N];
int main(){
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    memset(hasFriend,false,sizeof hasFriend);
    while(n -- ){
        int k;
        cin &gt;&gt; k;
        for(int i = 0;i &lt; k;i++){
            int x;
            cin &gt;&gt; x;
            if(k &gt; 1) {//有朋友
                hasFriend[x] = true;
            }
        }
    }
    int m;
    cin &gt;&gt; m;
    int count = 0;
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; m;i++){
        int q;
        cin &gt;&gt; q;
        if(!hasFriend[q]){
            if(count &gt; 0) cout &lt;&lt; " ";
            count++;
            printf("%05d",q);
            hasFriend[q] = true;// 去重
        }
    }
    if(count == 0){
        cout &lt;&lt; "No one is handsome" ;
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-c++">并查集解法(是我刚开始想复杂了)
#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
const int N = 100005;
int fa[N];
int sz[N];
bool vis[N];
int find(int x){
    return fa[x] = (fa[x] == x ? x : find(fa[x]));
}
void merge(int a,int b){
    int x = find(a),y = find(b);
    if(x == y) return ;
    fa[x] = y;
    sz[y] += sz[x];
}
int main(){
    for(int i = 0; i &lt; N;i++){
        fa[i] = i;
        sz[i] = 1;
    }
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    while(n--){
        int k;
        cin &gt;&gt; k;
        vector&lt;int&gt; a(k);
        for(int i = 0;i &lt; k;i++) cin &gt;&gt; a[i];
        for(int i = 0;i &lt; k - 1;i ++) merge(a[i],a[i + 1]);
    }
    int m;
    cin &gt;&gt; m;
    int cnt = 0;
    while(m--){
        int query;
        cin &gt;&gt; query;
        //cout &lt;&lt; find(query) &lt;&lt; "\n";
        if(sz[find(query)] == 1 &amp;&amp; !vis[query]){
            vis[query] = true;
            if(cnt) cout &lt;&lt; " ";
            printf("%05d",query);
            cnt++;
        }
    }
    if(cnt == 0) cout &lt;&lt;"No one is handsome";
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-022-奇偶分家"><strong>L1-022 奇偶分家</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    int tot = n;
    int odd = 0;
    while(n--){
        int x;
        cin &gt;&gt; x;
        odd += (x &amp; 1);
    }
    cout &lt;&lt; odd &lt;&lt; " " &lt;&lt; tot - odd;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-023-输出gplt"><strong>L1-023 输出GPLT</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main()
{
    string a;
    getline(cin,a);
    unordered_map&lt;char,int&gt; cnt;
    for(char c:a)
    {
        if(c=='g' || c=='G')    cnt['G']++;
        if(c=='p' || c=='P')    cnt['P']++;
        if(c=='L' || c=='l')    cnt['L']++;
        if(c=='t' || c=='T')    cnt['T']++;
    }
    string ans="";
    while(cnt['G']!=0 || cnt['P']!=0 ||cnt['L']!=0 ||cnt['T']!=0 )
    {
        if(cnt['G']!=0)
        {
            ans+='G';
            cnt['G']--;
        }
          if(cnt['P']!=0)
        {
            ans+='P';
            cnt['P']--;
        }
           if(cnt['L']!=0)
        {
            ans+='L';
            cnt['L']--;
        }
           if(cnt['T']!=0)
        {
            ans+='T';
            cnt['T']--;
        }
    }
    cout&lt;&lt;ans;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-025-正整数ab"><strong>L1-025 正整数A+B</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
bool check(string s){
    if(s.empty() ){
        return false;
    }
    int len = 0;
    int flag = false;
    for(char c : s){
        if(!(c &gt;= '0' &amp;&amp; c &lt;= '9')){
            return false;
        }
        if(c != '0') flag = true;
        if(flag) len++;
        if(len &gt; 4) return false;
    }
    int x = stoi(s);
    return (x &gt;= 1 &amp;&amp; x &lt;= 1000);
}

int main(){
    string a,b;
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);  // 读取整行输入
    int space_pos = line.find(' ');  // 找到第一个空格的位置
    a = line.substr(0, space_pos);   // A是第一个空格前的部分
    b = line.substr(space_pos + 1);  // B是第一个空格后的部分

    // 你原来的输出逻辑，完全保留，不做任何修改
    if(check(a) &amp;&amp; check(b)){
        int x = stoi(a),y = stoi(b);
        printf("%d + %d = %d",x,y, x + y);
    }else if(check(a)){
        int x = stoi(a);
        printf("%d + ? = ?",x);
    }else if(check(b)){
        int y = stoi(b);
        printf("? + %d = ?",y);
    }else{
        printf("? + ? = ?");
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-027-出租"><strong>L1-027 出租</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int cnt[10];
int main(){
    string s ;
    cin &gt;&gt; s;

    for(char c : s){
        cnt[c - '0']++;
    }
    vector&lt;int&gt; arr;
    for(int i = 9;i &gt;= 0;i--){
        if(cnt[i] &gt; 0) arr.push_back(i);
    }
    vector&lt;int&gt; index(11);
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; 11;i++){
        for(int j = 0;j &lt; arr.size();j++){
            if(arr[j] == s[i] - '0'){
                index[i] = j;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("int[] arr = new int[]{");
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; arr.size();i++){
        if(i) cout &lt;&lt;",";
        cout &lt;&lt; arr[i];
    }
    cout &lt;&lt;"};\n";
    printf("int[] index = new int[]{");
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; index.size();i++){
        if(i) cout &lt;&lt;",";
        cout &lt;&lt; index[i];
    }
    cout &lt;&lt;"};";
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

    return true;

<h2 id="l1-030-一帮一"><strong>L1-030 一帮一</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    vector&lt;int&gt; sex(n);
    vector&lt;string&gt; girls;
    vector&lt;string&gt; boys;
    vector&lt;string&gt; name(n);
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++){
        cin &gt;&gt; sex[i] &gt;&gt; name[i];
        if(sex[i] == 0){
            girls.push_back(name[i]);
        }else{
            boys.push_back(name[i]);
        }
    }
    int sz = n / 2;
    int idx1 = sz,idx2 = sz;
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; sz;i++){
        cout &lt;&lt; name[i] &lt;&lt; " ";
        if(sex[i] == 0){
            cout &lt;&lt; boys[--idx1] &lt;&lt; "\n"; 
        }else{
            cout &lt;&lt; girls[--idx2] &lt;&lt; "\n"; 
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

using namespace std;
bool check(int x,int n){
    set&lt;char&gt; st;
    st.clear();
    string s = to_string(x);
    if(s.size() &lt; 4) st.insert('0');
    for(char c : s) st.insert(c);
    return st.size() == n;
}
int main(){
    int n,y;
    cin &gt;&gt; y &gt;&gt; n;
    int ans = 0;
    for(int i = y;i ;i++){
        if(check(i,n)){
            ans  = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    printf("%d %04d",ans - y,ans);
    return 0;
}

<h2 id="l1-039-古风排版"><strong>L1-039 古风排版</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    cin.ignore();
    string s;
    getline(cin,s);
    int sz = s.size();
    int m = (sz + n - 1) / n;
    int idx = 0;
    vector&lt;vector&lt;char&gt;&gt; a(n,vector&lt;char&gt;(m,' '));
    for(int j = m - 1;j &gt;= 0;j--){
        for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++){
            a[i][j] = s[idx++];
            if(idx == sz){
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++){
        for(int j = 0;j &lt; m;j++){
            cout &lt;&lt; a[i][j] ; 
        }
        cout &lt;&lt; "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-043-阅览室"><strong>L1-043 阅览室</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int last[3601],vis[3601];
int main(){
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++){
        memset(last,0,sizeof last);
        memset(vis,0,sizeof vis);
        int id,hh,mm;
        char op;
        int sumTime = 0,nowTime= 0;
        int avg = 0;
        int cnt = 0;
        while(true){
            scanf("%d %c %d:%d",&amp;id,&amp;op,&amp;hh,&amp;mm);
            nowTime = hh * 60 + mm;
            if(id == 0){
                printf("%d ",cnt);
                if(cnt &gt; 0){
                    avg = round( 1.0*sumTime / cnt );
                }else{
                    avg = 0;
                }
                printf("%d\n",avg);
                break;
            }else if(op == 'S'){
                vis[id] = 1;
                last[id]  = nowTime;
            }else if(op == 'E' &amp;&amp; vis[id]){
                sumTime += nowTime - last[id];
                vis[id] = 0;
                cnt++;
            }
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-046-整除光棍"><strong>L1-046 整除光棍</strong></h2>
<p>模拟除法</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int s = 0,x,digit = 0;  // s：当前构建的光棍数片段（或余数）；digit：当前光棍数的位数
    cin &gt;&gt; x;

    // 第一步：构建初始的光棍数片段，直到≥x（除法需要被除数≥除数才能开始算商）
    while(s &lt; x){
        s = s * 10 + 1;  // 每次加一个1（比如1→11→111）
        digit++;         // 位数加1
    }

    // 第二步：模拟除法，逐位算商+更新余数，直到余数为0
    while(1){
        cout &lt;&lt; s / x;   // 输出当前商的一位（这是最终s的一位）
        s %= x;          // 取余数（后续用余数补1继续算）
        if(s == 0){      // 余数为0，说明当前光棍数能被x整除，结束
            break;
        }
        s = s * 10 + 1;  // 余数补1（相当于光棍数后面加一个1）
        digit++;         // 位数加1
    }

    cout &lt;&lt; " " &lt;&lt; digit;  // 输出最终位数
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

        return true;
    return false;
}
int main(){
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    while(n--){
        string name;
        int breath,pulse;
        cin &gt;&gt; name &gt;&gt; breath &gt;&gt; pulse;

            cout &lt;&lt; name &lt;&lt; "\n";
        }
    }

}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-048-矩阵a乘以b"><strong>L1-048 矩阵A乘以B</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int rA, cA;
    cin &gt;&gt; rA &gt;&gt; cA;
    vector&lt;vector&lt;int&gt;&gt; A(rA, vector&lt;int&gt;(cA));
    for (auto&amp; row : A) for (int&amp; x : row) cin &gt;&gt; x;

    int rB, cB;
    cin &gt;&gt; rB &gt;&gt; cB;
    vector&lt;vector&lt;int&gt;&gt; B(rB, vector&lt;int&gt;(cB));
    for (auto&amp; row : B) for (int&amp; x : row) cin &gt;&gt; x;

    if (cA != rB) {
        cout &lt;&lt; "Error: " &lt;&lt; cA &lt;&lt; " != " &lt;&lt; rB;
        return 0;
    }

    vector&lt;vector&lt;int&gt;&gt; C(rA, vector&lt;int&gt;(cB));
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; rA; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j &lt; cA; ++j)
            for (int k = 0; k &lt; cB; ++k)
                C[i][k] += A[i][j] * B[j][k];

    cout &lt;&lt; rA &lt;&lt; " " &lt;&lt; cB &lt;&lt; "\n";
    for (auto&amp; row : C) {
        for (int k = 0; k &lt; row.size(); ++k)
            cout &lt;&lt; (k ? " " : "") &lt;&lt; row[k];
        cout &lt;&lt; "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-049-天梯赛座位分配"><strong>L1-049 天梯赛座位分配</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int id_school[105*1005];
int main() {
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    vector&lt;int&gt; m(n + 1);
    vector&lt;vector&lt;int&gt;&gt; v(n  + 1);
    for(int i = 1; i &lt;= n;i++){
        cin &gt;&gt; m[i];
    }
    int cnt = 1;
    while(true){
        bool flag = true;
        for(int i = 1;i &lt;= n;i++){
            if(v[i].size() &lt; m[i]*10){
                if(id_school[cnt - 1] != i){
                    id_school[cnt] = i;
                    v[i].push_back(cnt);
                    cnt ++;
                }else{
                    id_school[cnt + 1] = i;
                    v[i].push_back(cnt + 1);
                    cnt += 2;
                }
                flag = false;
            }
        }
        if(flag) break;
    }
    for(int i = 1;i &lt;= n;i++){
        cout &lt;&lt; "#" &lt;&lt; i ;
        for(int j = 0;j &lt; v[i].size();j++){
            if(j % 10 == 0) cout &lt;&lt; "\n";
            else cout &lt;&lt; " ";
            cout &lt;&lt; v[i][j];
        }
        cout &lt;&lt; "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-050-倒数第n个字符串"><strong>L1-050 倒数第N个字符串</strong></h2>
<p>字符串题转化为26进制 最高位权重最大</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main() {
    int l,n;
    cin &gt;&gt; l &gt;&gt; n;
    int now = pow(26,l) - n;
    vector&lt;char&gt; a;
    while(now){
        a.push_back((char)((now % 26) + 'a'));
        now /= 26;
    }
    string ans = "";
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; l - (int)a.size();i++){
        ans += 'a';
    }
    for(int i = a.size() - 1;i &gt;= 0;i--){
        ans += a[i];
    }
    cout &lt;&lt; ans;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-054-福到了"><strong>L1-054 福到了</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
const int N = 105;
char mp[N][N];
char cp[N][N];
int main() {
    char c;
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; c &gt;&gt; n;
    cin.ignore();
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++){
        string s;
        getline(cin,s);
        for(int j = 0;j &lt; n;j++){
            mp[i][j] = s[j];
            cp[n - i - 1][n - j - 1] = s[j];
        }
    }
    bool flag = true;
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++){
        for(int j = 0;j &lt; n;j++){
            if(mp[i][j] != cp[i][j]){
                flag = false;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if(flag)  cout &lt;&lt; "bu yong dao le\n";
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++){
        for(int j = 0;j &lt; n;j++){
            if(cp[i][j] == '@'){
                cout &lt;&lt; c;
            }else {
                cout &lt;&lt; cp[i][j];
            }
        }
        cout &lt;&lt; "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-055-谁是赢家"><strong>L1-055 谁是赢家</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main() {
    int pa,pb;
    cin &gt;&gt; pa &gt;&gt; pb;
    int a = 0,b = 0;
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; 3;i++){
        int x;
        cin &gt;&gt; x;
        a += x == 0;
        b += x == 1;
    }
    if(pa &gt; pb){
        if(a &gt; 0){
            printf("The winner is a: %d + %d",pa,a);
        }else{
            printf("The winner is b: %d + %d",pb,b);
        }
    }else{
        if(a &gt; 0){
            printf("The winner is a: %d + %d",pa,a);
        }else{
            printf("The winner is b: %d + %d",pb,b);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-056-猜数字"><strong>L1-056 猜数字</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
const int N = 1e4+ 9;
struct{
    string name;
    int score;
}a[N];
int main() {
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    int sum = 0 ;
    for(int i = 0;i&lt; n;i++){
        cin &gt;&gt; a[i].name &gt;&gt; a[i].score;
        sum += a[i].score;
    }
    int avg = sum / n/2;
    string ans;
    int mn = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    for(int i = 0;i&lt; n;i++){
        if(abs(a[i].score - avg) &lt; mn){
            mn = abs(a[i].score - avg);
            ans = a[i].name;
        }
    }
    cout &lt;&lt; avg &lt;&lt; " " &lt;&lt;ans;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-058-6翻了"><strong>L1-058 6翻了</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main() {
    string s;
    getline(cin,s);
    int n = s.size();
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++){
        int start = i;
        int j = i;
        while(j &lt; n &amp;&amp; s[j] == '6' &amp;&amp; s[j] == s[start]){
            j++;
        }
        if(j == i){
            cout &lt;&lt; s[i];
        }else{
            int len = j - start;
            if(len &gt; 3 &amp;&amp; len &lt;= 9) cout &lt;&lt;'9';
            else if(len &gt; 9) cout &lt;&lt; "27";
            else{
                while(start != j){
                    cout &lt;&lt; s[start++];
                }
            }
            i = j - 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-059-敲笨钟"><strong>L1-059 敲笨钟</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;iostream&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
	int n,flag;
	cin&gt;&gt;n;
	getchar();//注意
	string s;
	int i=0,j,k;
	while(n--){
		getline(cin,s);
		for(i=0;i&lt;s.size();i++){
			if(s[i]==','){
				if(s[i-1]!='g'||s[i-2]!='n'||s[i-3]!='o'){
					cout&lt;&lt;"Skipped"&lt;&lt;endl;
					break;
				}
				else
				flag=1;
			}
			if(s[i]=='.'){
				if(s[i-1]!='g'||s[i-2]!='n'||s[i-3]!='o'){
					cout&lt;&lt;"Skipped"&lt;&lt;endl;
					break;
				}else{
					if(flag==1){
						k=0;
						j=i;
						while(k!=3) {
							j--;
							if(s[j]==' ')
							k++;	
						}
						s=s.substr(0,j)+" qiao ben zhong.";
						cout&lt;&lt;s&lt;&lt;endl;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

<h2 id="l1-064-估值一亿的ai核心代码"><strong>L1-064 估值一亿的AI核心代码</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-java">import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        // 读取第一行
        if (sc.hasNextLine()) {
            sc.nextLine();
        }
        
        // 循环读取后续每行输入
        while (sc.hasNextLine()) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            System.out.println(s); // 原样打印输入
            System.out.print("AI: ");
            
            // 1. 合并多空格为1个
            s = s.replaceAll(Pattern.quote("\\s+"), " ");
            s = s.replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
            
            // 2. 删首尾空格 + 删标点前的空格
            s = s.replaceAll("^\\s+|\\s+$|\\s+(?=\\W)", "");
            
            // 3. 标记独立的I为mark_mark
            s = s.replaceAll("\\bI\\b", "mark_mark");
            
            // 4. 所有字符转小写（除了原有的I）
            char[] chars = s.toCharArray();
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; chars.length; i++) {
                if (chars[i] != 'I') {
                    chars[i] = Character.toLowerCase(chars[i]);
                }
            }
            s = new String(chars);
            
            // 5. 替换can you/could you
            s = s.replaceAll("\\bcan you\\b", "I can");
            s = s.replaceAll("\\bcould you\\b", "I could");
            
            // 6. 替换mark_mark（原I）和me为you
            s = s.replaceAll("mark_mark|\\bme\\b", "you");
            
            // 7. 问号转感叹号
            s = s.replaceAll("\\?", "!");
            
            // 输出结果
            System.out.println(s);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
</code></pre>

<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    vector&lt;int&gt; a(4);
    int mx = 0;
    for(int i = 1;i &lt;= 4;i++) {
        cin &gt;&gt; a[i];
        mx = max(mx,a[i]);
    }
    int mn ,limit;
    cin &gt;&gt; mn &gt;&gt; limit;
    int cnt = 0;
    bool uplimit = true;
    int error;
    for(int i = 1;i &lt;= 4;i++){
        int x = a[i];
        if(x &lt; mn || mx - x &gt; limit){
            cnt ++;
            error = i;
        }
    }
    if(cnt == 0 ){
        cout &lt;&lt; "Normal";
    }else if(cnt == 1){
        printf("Warning: please check #%d!",error);
    }else{
        printf("Warning: please check all the tires!");
    }
    return 0;    
}

<h2 id="l1-070-吃火锅"><strong>L1-070 吃火锅</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-java">import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.regex.*;
public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String regex = "chi1 huo3 guo1";
        Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile(regex);
        int tot = 0;
        int first = 0,cnt = 0;
        while(true){
            String line;
            line = sc.nextLine().trim();
            if(".".equals(line)){
                break;
            }
            tot++;
            Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(line);
            if(matcher.find()){
                if(first == 0)
                    first = tot;
                cnt++;
            }   
        }
        System.out.println(tot);
        if(cnt == 0) {
            System.out.println("-_-#");
        }else{
            System.out.println(first + " " + cnt);
        }
        
        sc.close();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-071-前世档案"><strong>L1-071 前世档案</strong></h2>
<p>完全二叉树的性质</p>
<p>根节点为1  高度(第一层为1)为i的左孩子节点为2<em>i 右孩子为2</em>i + 1</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int n,m;
    cin &gt;&gt; n &gt;&gt; m;
    //y 2*i n 2*i+1
    vector&lt;int&gt; ans(m);
    for(int i = 0; i &lt; m;i++){
        string s;
        cin &gt;&gt; s;
        int x = 1;//根节点
        for(int j = 0;j &lt; n;j++){
            x &lt;&lt;= 1;
            x += (s[j] == 'n');
        }
        ans[i] = x - ((1 &lt;&lt; n) - 1); // 最后一层从1开始编号，-前n -1层问题总数
    }
    for(int i = 0; i &lt; m;i++){
        cout &lt;&lt; ans[i] &lt;&lt; "\n";
    }
    return 0;    
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-072-刮刮彩票"><strong>L1-072 刮刮彩票</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int  a[5][5];
int sum (int flag){
    int tot = 0;
    if(flag &gt;=1 &amp;&amp; flag &lt;= 3){
        for(int j  = 1;j  &lt;= 3;j++){
            tot += a[flag][j];
        }
        return tot;
    }else if(flag &gt;=4 &amp;&amp; flag &lt;= 6){
        for(int i = 1;i &lt;= 3;i++){
            tot += a[i][flag - 3];
        }
        return tot;
    }
    if(flag == 7){
        for(int i = 1;i &lt;= 3;i++){
            tot += a[i][i];
        }
        return tot;
    }
    for(int i = 1;i &lt;= 3;i++){
            tot += a[4 - i][i];
        }
    return tot;
}
int main(){
    vector&lt;bool&gt; vis(10);
    int money[] = {0,0,0,0,0,0,10000,36,720,360,80,252,108,72,54,180,72,180,119
                   ,36,306,1080,144,1800,3600};
    int zi,zj;
    for(int i = 1 ; i &lt;= 3;i++){
        for(int j = 1 ;j &lt;= 3;j++){
            cin &gt;&gt; a[i][j];
            if(a[i][j] == 0){
                zi = i;
                zj = j;
            }
            vis[a[i][j]] = true;
        }
    }
    int zero = 0;
    for(int x = 1; x &lt;= 9;x++)    if(!vis[x]) zero = x;
    a[zi][zj] = zero;
    //cout&lt;&lt;zero&lt;&lt;"---------\n";
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; 3;i++){
        int x,y;
        cin &gt;&gt; x &gt;&gt; y;
        cout &lt;&lt; a[x][y] &lt;&lt;"\n";
    }
    int flag ;
    cin &gt;&gt; flag;
    //cout&lt;&lt;sum(flag)&lt;&lt;"---------\n";
    int ans = money[sum(flag)];
    cout &lt;&lt; ans;
    return 0;    
}

<h2 id="l1-080-乘法口诀数列"><strong>L1-080 乘法口诀数列</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
const int N = 15000;
int a[N];
int main(){
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; a[1] &gt;&gt; a[2];
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    int idx = 3;
    int now = 1;
    while(idx &lt;= n){
        int x = a[now] * a[now + 1];
        if(x &gt; 9) {
            a[idx++] = x / 10;
            a[idx++] = x % 10;
        }else{
            a[idx++] = x ;
        }
        now ++;
    }
    for(int i = 1;i &lt;= n;i++){
        if(i &gt; 1) cout &lt;&lt; " ";
        cout &lt;&lt; a[i];
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-083-谁能进图书馆"><strong>L1-083 谁能进图书馆</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int a,b,x,y;
    cin &gt;&gt; a &gt;&gt; b &gt;&gt; x &gt;&gt; y;
    if(x &lt; a &amp;&amp; y &gt;= b){
        printf("%d-Y %d-Y\n",x,y);
        cout &lt;&lt; "qing 2 zhao gu hao 1\n";
    }else if(y &lt; a &amp;&amp; x &gt;= b){
        printf("%d-Y %d-Y\n",x,y);
        cout &lt;&lt; "qing 1 zhao gu hao 2\n";
    }else if(x &gt;= a &amp;&amp; y &gt;= a){
        printf("%d-Y %d-Y\n",x,y);
        cout &lt;&lt; "huan ying ru guan\n";
    }else if(x &lt; a &amp;&amp; y &lt; a){
        printf("%d-N %d-N\n",x,y);
        cout &lt;&lt; "zhang da zai lai ba\n";
    }else{
        if(x &gt;= a){
            cout &lt;&lt; x &lt;&lt;"-" &lt;&lt;"Y ";
            cout &lt;&lt; y &lt;&lt;"-" &lt;&lt;"N\n";
            cout &lt;&lt; 1 &lt;&lt; ": huan ying ru guan";
        }else{
            cout &lt;&lt; x &lt;&lt;"-" &lt;&lt;"N ";
            cout &lt;&lt; y &lt;&lt;"-" &lt;&lt;"Y\n";
            cout &lt;&lt; 2 &lt;&lt; ": huan ying ru guan";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

bool vis[6][7];
int main(){

    for(int i = 0;i &lt; 6;i++){
        int x;
        cin &gt;&gt; x;
        vis[i][x] = true;
    }
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++){
        for(int j = 0;j &lt; 6;j++){
            if(j &amp;&amp; i == n - 1 ) cout &lt;&lt;" ";
            for(int k = 6;k &gt;= 1;k--){
                if(!vis[j][k]){
                    vis[j][k] = true;
                    if(i == n - 1 )
                    cout &lt;&lt; k;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

<h2 id="l1-086-斯德哥尔摩火车上的题"><strong>L1-086 斯德哥尔摩火车上的题</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
string f(string a){
    string s = "";
    for(int i = 1;i &lt; a.size();i++){
        int x = a [i] - '0',y = a[i - 1] - '0';
        if(x%2 == y %2){
            s += to_string(max(x,y));
        }
    }
    return s;
}
int main(){
    string a,b;
    cin &gt;&gt; a &gt;&gt; b;
    string s = f(a);
    string t = f(b);
    if(s == t){
        cout &lt;&lt; s;
    }else{
        cout &lt;&lt; s &lt;&lt;"\n" &lt;&lt;t;
    }
    
    return 0;
}

<h2 id="l1-087-机工士姆斯塔迪奥"><strong>L1-087 机工士姆斯塔迪奥</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int n,m,q;
    cin &gt;&gt; n &gt;&gt; m &gt;&gt; q;
    set&lt;int&gt; row;
    set&lt;int&gt; col;
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; q;i++){
        int op,x;
        cin &gt;&gt; op &gt;&gt; x;
        if(op == 0){
            row.insert(x);
        }else{
            col.insert(x);
        }
    }
    //int ans = n * m - m * row.size() - n * col.size() + row.size() * col.size();
    int ans = (n - row.size()) * (m - col.size());
    cout &lt;&lt; ans;
    return 0;
}

    int n,k,s;
    cin &gt;&gt; n &gt;&gt; k &gt;&gt; s;
    int ans = 0;
    for(int i = 1;i &lt;= n;i++){
        int tian,pat;
        cin &gt;&gt; tian &gt;&gt; pat;
        if(tian &lt; 175) continue;
        if(pat &gt;= s) ans++;
        else         t[tian]++;
    }
    for(int i = 175;i &lt;= 290;i++){
        ans += min(t[i],k);
    }
    cout &lt;&lt; ans;
    return 0;
}

        bool isRight = false;
        vector&lt;int&gt; b(n);

                isRight = true;

                isRight = false;
                break;

<h2 id="l1-094-剪切粘贴"><strong>L1-094 剪切粘贴</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    string s;
    cin &gt;&gt; s;
    int n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    while(n--){
        int x,y;
        string s1,s2;
        cin &gt;&gt; x &gt;&gt; y &gt;&gt; s1 &gt;&gt; s2;
        string cut = s.substr(x - 1,y - x + 1);
        s.erase(s.begin() + x - 1,s.begin() + y);
        int len = s1.size();
        s1 = s1 + s2;
        if(s.find(s1) != string::npos){
            int pos = s.find(s1);
            s.insert(pos + len,cut);
        }else{
            s.insert(s.size(),cut);
        }
    }
    cout &lt;&lt; s;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-095-分寝室"><strong>L1-095 分寝室</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int n0,n1,n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n0 &gt;&gt; n1 &gt;&gt; n;
    int mn = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    int f,m;
    for(int i = 1;i &lt; n;i++){
        int j = n - i;
        if(n0 % i == 0 &amp;&amp; n1 % j == 0){
            int boy = n0 / i,girl = n1 / j;
            if(boy == 1 || girl == 1) continue; 
            int div = abs(boy - girl);
            if(div &lt; mn){
                mn = div;
                f = i;
                m = j;
            }
        }
    }
    if(mn != 0x3f3f3f3f){
        cout &lt;&lt; f &lt;&lt; " " &lt;&lt; m;
    }else{
        cout &lt;&lt; "No Solution";
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-096-谁管谁叫爹"><strong>L1-096 谁管谁叫爹</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int f(long long x){
    int sum = 0;
    while(x){
        sum += x % 10;
        x /= 10;
    }
    return sum;
}
int main(){
    int n; 
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    while(n--){
        long long a,b;
        cin &gt;&gt; a &gt;&gt; b;
        if((a % f(b) == 0) != (b % f(a) == 0)){
            if(a % f(b) == 0) cout &lt;&lt;"A\n";
            else cout &lt;&lt; "B\n";
        }else{
            if(a &gt; b)  cout &lt;&lt;"A\n";
            else cout &lt;&lt; "B\n";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-103-整数的持续性"><strong>L1-103 整数的持续性</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include "bits/stdc++.h"
using namespace std;
int f(int x)
{
    int sum=1;
    while(x)
    {
        sum*=(x%10);
        x/=10;
    }
    return sum;
}
int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int a,b;cin&gt;&gt;a&gt;&gt;b;
    int mx=0;
    vector&lt;int&gt; g[5050];
    for(int i=a;i&lt;=b;i++)
    {
        int cnt=0;
        int x=i;
        while(x&gt;=10)
        {
           cnt++;
            x=f(x);
        }
        if(cnt&gt;=mx)
        {
            mx=cnt;
            g[mx].push_back(i);
        }
    }
    cout&lt;&lt;mx&lt;&lt;"\n";
    for(int i=0;i&lt;(int)g[mx].size();i++)
    {
        cout&lt;&lt;g[mx][i];
        if(i==(int)g[mx].size()-1)continue;
        cout&lt;&lt;" ";
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-104-九宫格"><strong>L1-104 九宫格</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">

#include "bits/stdc++.h"

using namespace std;

void solve() {
    int n = 9;
    vector a(n, vector&lt;int&gt;(n));
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j &lt; n; j++) {
            cin &gt;&gt; a[i][j];
            a[i][j]--;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; i += 3) {
        for (int j = 0; j &lt; n; j += 3) {
            vector&lt;int&gt; c(n);

            for (int x = 0; x &lt; 3; x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y &lt; 3; y++) {
                    if (a[i + x][j + y] &lt; 0 || a[i + x][j + y] &gt;= 9) {
                        cout &lt;&lt; "0\n";
                        return;
                    }
                    c[a[i + x][j + y]]++;
                }
            }
            if (c != vector&lt;int&gt;(n, 1)) {
                cout &lt;&lt; "0\n";
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i &lt; n; i++) {
        vector&lt;int&gt; c(n);

        for (int j = 0; j &lt; n; j++) {
            c[a[i][j]]++;
        }
        if (c != vector&lt;int&gt;(n, 1)) {
            cout &lt;&lt; "0\n";
            return;
        }
        
        c.assign(n, 0);
        for (int j = 0; j &lt; n; j++) {
            c[a[j][i]]++;
        }
        if (c != vector&lt;int&gt;(n, 1)) {
            cout &lt;&lt; "0\n";
            return;
        }
    }

    cout &lt;&lt; "1\n";
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int t;
    cin &gt;&gt; t;
    while (t--) {
        solve();
    }

    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="l1-109-这是字符串题"><strong>L1-109 这是字符串题</strong></h2>

using namespace std;
int cnt[26];
int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    string s ;
    cin &gt;&gt; s;
    for(char c : s){
        cnt[c - 'a'] ++;
    }
    int ans  = 0;
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; 26;i++){
        int x;
        cin &gt;&gt; x;
        ans += x * cnt[i];
    }
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; 26;i++){
        if(i) cout &lt;&lt; " ";

<h2 id="l1-110-这不是字符串题"><strong>L1-110 这不是字符串题</strong></h2>
<p>看数据范围输出的正整数1~26 ，可以转化为字符串方便操作</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">//带空格
#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    int n,m;
    string a = " ";
    cin &gt;&gt; n &gt;&gt; m;
    for(int i = 0; i &lt; n;i++){
        int x;
        cin &gt;&gt; x;
        a += (char)(x - 1 + 'a');
    }
    while(m--){
        int opt;
        cin &gt;&gt; opt;
        if(opt == 1){
            int L1,L2,x;
            string s1 = "",s2 = "";
            cin &gt;&gt; L1;
            for(int i = 0;i &lt; L1;i++){
                cin &gt;&gt; x;
                s1 += (char)(x - 1 + 'a');
            }
            cin &gt;&gt; L2;
            for(int i = 0;i &lt; L2;i++){
                cin &gt;&gt; x;
                s2 += (char)(x - 1 + 'a');
            }
            if(a.find(s1) != string::npos){
                int pos = a.find(s1);
                a.erase(a.begin() + pos,a.begin() + pos + L1);
                a.insert(pos,s2);
            }
        }else if(opt == 2){
            string b = a;
            int pos = 1;
            for(int i = 1;i &lt; b.size() - 1;i++){
                if((b[i] &amp; 1) == (b[i + 1] &amp; 1)){
                    a.insert(i + pos,string(1,(b[i] + b[i + 1]) / 2));
                    pos++;
                }
            }
        }else{
            int l,r;
            cin &gt;&gt; l &gt;&gt; r;
            reverse(a.begin() + l,a.begin() + r + 1);
        }
        // for(int i = 1;i &lt; a.size();i++){
        //     if(i != 1) cout &lt;&lt; " ";
        //     cout &lt;&lt; (a[i] - 'a' + 1);
        // }
        // cout &lt;&lt; "\n";
    }
    //cout &lt;&lt; a;
    for(int i = 1;i &lt; a.size();i++){
        if(i != 1) cout &lt;&lt; " ";
        cout &lt;&lt; (a[i] - 'a' + 1);
    }
    cout &lt;&lt; "\n";
    return 0;
}   
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-c++">//不带空格
#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using  namespace std;
int main()
{
	int  n,m;
	cin&gt;&gt;n&gt;&gt;m;
	string s="";
	for(int i = 0;i &lt; n;i++)
	{
		int x;
		cin &gt;&gt; x;
		s +=(char)(x-1+'a');
	}
	//cout&lt;&lt;s&lt;&lt;"\n";
	for(int i=0;i&lt;m;i++)
	{
		int opt;    cin&gt;&gt;opt;
		if(opt==1)
		{
			int l1,l2;
			cin&gt;&gt;l1;
			string t1="";
			for(int j=0;j&lt;l1;j++)
			{
				int x;cin&gt;&gt;x;
				t1+=(char)(x-1+'a');
			}    
			cin&gt;&gt;l2;
			string t2="";
			for(int j=0;j&lt;l2;j++)
			{
				int x;cin&gt;&gt;x;
				t2+=(char)(x-1+'a');
			}
			size_t idx=s.find(t1);
			if(idx!=string::npos)
			{
				s.replace(idx,l1,t2);
			}
//			cout&lt;&lt;(int)(s[0]-'a'+1);
//			for(int i = 1;i&lt;s.size();i++)
//			{
//				cout&lt;&lt;" "&lt;&lt;(int)(s[i]-'a'+1);
//			}
//			cout&lt;&lt;"\n";
		}
		else if(opt==2)
		{
			string temp="";
			for(int j=0;j&lt;s.size()-1;j++)
			{
				temp+=s[j];
				int x=s[j]-'a'+1+s[j+1]-'a'+1;
				if(x%2==0)
				{
					temp+=(char)(x/2-1+'a');
				}
			}
			temp+=s.back();
			s=temp;
//			cout&lt;&lt;(int)(s[0]-'a'+1);
//			for(int i = 1;i&lt;s.size();i++)
//			{
//				cout&lt;&lt;" "&lt;&lt;(int)(s[i]-'a'+1);
//			}
//			cout&lt;&lt;"\n";
		}
		else 
		{
			int l,r;
			cin&gt;&gt;l&gt;&gt;r;
			reverse(s.begin()+l-1,s.begin()+r);
//			cout&lt;&lt;(int)(s[0]-'a'+1);
//			for(int i = 1;i&lt;s.size();i++)
//			{
//				cout&lt;&lt;" "&lt;&lt;(int)(s[i]-'a'+1);
//			}
//			cout&lt;&lt;"\n";
		}
	}
	//cout&lt;&lt;s&lt;&lt;endl;
	cout&lt;&lt;(int)(s[0]-'a'+1);
	for(int i = 1;i&lt;s.size();i++)
	{
		cout&lt;&lt;" "&lt;&lt;(int)(s[i]-'a'+1);
	}
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-111-大幂数"><strong>L1-111 大幂数</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
int main(){
    long long  n;
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    bool check = false;
    for(int k = 31;k &gt;= 1;k--){
        long long sum = 0;
        int i = 1;
        while(sum &lt; n){
            sum += pow(i,k);
            i++;
        }
        if(sum == n){
            check = true;
            for(int j = 1;j &lt; i;j++){
                if(j != 1) cout &lt;&lt; "+";
                cout &lt;&lt; j &lt;&lt; "^" &lt;&lt; k;
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    if(!check) {
        cout &lt;&lt; "Impossible for " &lt;&lt; n &lt;&lt; ".";
    }
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="l1-112-现代战争"><strong>L1-112 现代战争</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include &lt;iostream&gt;
#include &lt;vector&gt;
#include &lt;queue&gt;
#include &lt;utility&gt;
#include &lt;tuple&gt;
using namespace std;
typedef tuple&lt;int,int,int&gt; tp;
int main() {
    int n, m, k;
    cin &gt;&gt; n &gt;&gt; m &gt;&gt; k;
    vector&lt;vector&lt;int&gt;&gt; g(n,vector&lt;int&gt;(m));
    priority_queue&lt;tp&gt; q;
    for(int i = 0; i &lt; n; i++)
        for(int j = 0 ;j &lt; m ;j++)    
        {
            cin&gt;&gt;g[i][j];
            q.push({g[i][j],i,j});
        }
    vector&lt;int&gt; col(n),row(m);
    while(k--)
    {
        auto [v,x,y] = q.top();
        q.pop();
        while(col[x] || row[y])
        {
            auto[vv,x1,y1]=q.top();
            q.pop();
            x = x1;
            y = y1;
        }
        col[x] = true;
        row[y] = true;
    }
    for(int i = 0;i &lt; n ;i++)
    {
        if(col[i])    continue;
        int first = 1;
        for(int  j = 0; j &lt; m;j++)
        {
            if(row[j])    continue;
           if(first) cout&lt;&lt;g[i][j];
            else   cout&lt;&lt;" "&lt;&lt;g[i][j];
            first = 0;
        }
        cout&lt;&lt;"\n";
    }
    return 0;
}    
</code></pre>
